name: Overnight Oats with Banana
instructions: Combine oats, almond milk, and chia seeds in a jar and stir well.
Refrigerate overnight (at least 6 hours).
Top with sliced banana and a drizzle of maple syrup before serving.

name: Scrambled Eggs on Toast
instructions: Crack and whisk eggs with a splash of milk, salt, and pepper.
Melt butter in a pan over low heat, add eggs, and stir gently until just set.
Serve on toasted whole grain bread.

name: Greek Yogurt with Berries & Walnuts
instructions: Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with mixed berries, roughly crushed walnuts, and a drizzle of honey.

name: Avocado & Poached Egg Toast
instructions: Toast sourdough. Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper and spread on toast.
Poach eggs in simmering water for 3 minutes, then place on top.

name: Protein Berry Smoothie
instructions: Add all ingredients to a blender and blitz until smooth.
Add extra almond milk for a thinner consistency if preferred.

name: Oat & Banana Pancakes
instructions: Blend oats, banana, eggs, and milk into a smooth batter.
Cook small pancakes in a non-stick pan over medium heat, about 2 min each side.
Serve with fresh fruit or a drizzle of honey.

name: Poached Eggs with Sautéed Spinach
instructions: Sauté garlic and cherry tomatoes in olive oil until softened, then wilt the spinach.
Poach eggs in simmering water for 3 minutes and serve on top of the spinach.

name: Muesli with Milk & Banana
instructions: Pour muesli into a bowl and add milk.
Slice banana on top and serve immediately, or soak overnight for a softer texture.

name: Chicken & Quinoa Power Bowl
instructions: Season and grill chicken breast for 6 min each side, then slice.
Assemble quinoa, cucumber, and tomatoes in a bowl.
Top with sliced chicken and drizzle with olive oil, lemon, and seasoning.

name: Red Lentil & Cumin Soup
instructions: Soften onion and garlic in a pan, then add cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add lentils and stock, bring to a boil, then simmer for 20 minutes until thick.
Blend partially or fully to your preferred consistency.

name: Tuna & Avocado Whole-Grain Wrap
instructions: Drain tuna and mix with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Spread mashed avocado on the tortilla, add tuna and lettuce, then wrap tightly.

name: Roasted Vegetable & Feta Salad
instructions: Toss vegetables in olive oil, season, and roast at 200°C for 20 minutes.
Let cool slightly, then toss with rocket, crumbled feta, and balsamic.

name: Turkey & Avocado Sandwich
instructions: Spread Dijon mustard on bread slices.
Layer turkey, mashed avocado, and lettuce, then close the sandwich.

name: Sesame Tofu Noodle Bowl
instructions: Press and cube tofu, then pan-fry until golden on all sides.
Cook noodles per packet instructions. Stir-fry peppers, add noodles and soy sauce.
Top with tofu and drizzle with sesame oil.

name: Chicken & Vegetable Soup
instructions: Sauté garlic in olive oil, then add diced chicken and brown.
Add vegetables and stock, bring to a boil, then simmer 15 minutes.

name: Quinoa & Black Bean Bowl
instructions: Rinse and drain black beans, mix with corn, cumin, salt, and lime juice.
Serve over cooked quinoa and garnish with fresh coriander if available.

name: Baked Salmon with Roasted Vegetables
instructions: Toss vegetables in olive oil and roast at 200°C for 10 minutes.
Place salmon on the tray, season with garlic, lemon zest, and salt.
Roast for a further 12–14 minutes until salmon is cooked through.

name: Chicken & Broccoli Stir-fry with Rice
instructions: Slice chicken and cook in a hot wok with grated ginger until golden.
Add broccoli florets and stir-fry 3–4 minutes, then splash in soy sauce.
Serve over cooked brown rice.

name: Vegetable Coconut Curry
instructions: Sauté vegetables with curry powder for 2 minutes, then add chickpeas.
Pour in coconut milk and simmer 15 minutes until sauce thickens.
Serve over basmati rice.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Cook spaghetti per packet. Soften onion and garlic, then brown the mince.
Add tomato sauce and simmer 15 minutes. Season to taste.
Toss with drained spaghetti and serve.

name: Grilled Chicken & Sweet Potato
instructions: Cube sweet potato, toss in olive oil and paprika, and roast at 200°C for 20 minutes.
Grill seasoned chicken breast for 6 min each side.
Steam or boil green beans and serve alongside.

name: Tofu & Vegetable Stir-fry
instructions: Press tofu dry, cube, and pan-fry in sesame oil until golden.
Add vegetables and stir-fry 3–4 minutes. Add soy sauce and toss.
Serve over jasmine rice.

name: Beef & Broccoli with Rice
instructions: Stir-fry beef strips in a hot wok with garlic until browned.
Add broccoli and oyster sauce, toss over high heat for 3 minutes.
Serve over steamed jasmine rice.

name: Baked Cod with Sweet Potato
instructions: Cube sweet potato and roast in olive oil at 200°C for 10 minutes.
Add cod to the tray with cherry tomatoes and lemon slices.
Roast a further 12 minutes until cod flakes easily.

name: Apple with Almond Butter
instructions: Slice apple and serve with almond butter for dipping.

name: Cottage Cheese with Berries
instructions: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl, top with berries and a drizzle of honey.

name: Hummus with Veggie Sticks
instructions: Cut carrots and cucumber into sticks and serve alongside hummus.

name: Mixed Nuts
instructions: Measure into a small bowl or portion bag for a portable snack.

name: Vanilla Protein Shake
instructions: Blend protein powder, milk, and banana until smooth.
Serve immediately or chill briefly.

name: Chocolate Chia Pudding
instructions: Whisk chia seeds, oat milk, cocoa powder, and maple syrup together in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight, stirring once after 30 minutes to prevent clumping.
Top with mixed berries before serving.

name: Vegetable Omelette
instructions: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper. Sauté pepper and tomatoes in olive oil for 2 minutes.
Add spinach until wilted, then pour over eggs.
Cook on low until set, scatter cheese, fold, and serve.

name: Granola & Yogurt Parfait
instructions: Layer Greek yogurt in a glass, add granola, then berries.
Repeat layers and drizzle honey on top.

name: Smoked Salmon Bagel
instructions: Slice and lightly toast the bagel.
Spread cream cheese on both halves, layer smoked salmon and cucumber.
Scatter capers and squeeze lemon juice over the top.

name: Peanut Butter & Banana Toast
instructions: Toast the bread to your liking.
Spread peanut butter generously on each slice.
Top with banana slices and a pinch of cinnamon.

name: Egg White & Mushroom Omelette
instructions: Slice mushrooms and sauté with a little oil until golden.
Add spinach and wilt. Season egg whites and pour over the vegetables.
Cook on low, folding once, until just set. Garnish with fresh herbs.

name: Açaí Smoothie Bowl
instructions: Blend açaí, frozen banana, and almond milk until thick and smooth.
Pour into a bowl and top with granola, berries, and coconut flakes.

name: Cottage Cheese & Tomato Toast
instructions: Toast bread and spread with cottage cheese.
Top with sliced tomatoes, chives, salt, and cracked pepper.

name: Grilled Salmon & Spinach Salad
instructions: Season salmon and grill for 5–6 minutes each side.
Toss spinach, tomatoes, and avocado with olive oil and balsamic.
Flake salmon over the salad and serve warm.

name: Chickpea & Roasted Pepper Wrap
instructions: Mash chickpeas lightly with lemon juice, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Spread hummus on the tortilla, layer lettuce, roasted pepper, and chickpeas.
Roll tightly and slice in half to serve.

name: Garlic Prawn Rice Bowl
instructions: Blanch broccoli for 2 minutes. Sauté garlic in sesame oil until fragrant.
Add prawns and cook for 2–3 minutes until pink. Add soy sauce.
Serve over jasmine rice with broccoli.

name: Mushroom & Parmesan Risotto
instructions: Sauté onion in olive oil until soft. Add rice and toast for 1 minute.
Add warm stock one ladle at a time, stirring constantly for 20 minutes.
Fold in sautéed mushrooms and parmesan, season, and serve.

name: Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a wok on high heat. Add cold rice and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Push rice to one side, scramble eggs in the centre, then fold in.
Add peas, spring onions, and soy sauce. Toss for 2 more minutes.

name: Greek Salad with Grilled Chicken
instructions: Grill seasoned chicken breast for 6 minutes each side, then slice.
Combine cucumber, tomatoes, olives, and feta in a bowl.
Dress with olive oil, oregano, and season to taste. Top with chicken.

name: Lentil Bolognese Pasta
instructions: Cook lentils in water for 15 minutes until tender, then drain.
Sauté garlic, carrot, and celery, add lentils and tomato sauce, simmer 10 minutes.
Cook pasta, drain, and toss with the lentil sauce.

name: Spicy Beef & Rice Bowl
instructions: Brown beef mince in a hot pan, drain excess fat.
Stir in gochujang paste and soy sauce, cook 2 minutes.
Serve over rice with edamame and spring onions.

name: Turkey Meatballs & Zucchini Noodles
instructions: Mix turkey mince with egg, garlic, herbs, salt, and pepper. Roll into 12 meatballs.
Brown meatballs in olive oil, then simmer in tomato sauce for 15 minutes.
Spiralize zucchini and sauté for 2 minutes. Serve topped with meatballs and sauce.

name: Herb-Crusted Pork Tenderloin
instructions: Rub pork with mustard, rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Sear in ovenproof pan, then roast at 200°C for 18–20 minutes. Rest 5 minutes before slicing.
Roast sweet potato cubes and steam green beans alongside.

name: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta per packet instructions.
Sauté garlic and mushrooms in butter until golden, add cream and thyme. Simmer 3 minutes.
Toss with drained pasta, season, and finish with grated parmesan.

name: Prawn & Vegetable Stir-fry
instructions: Stir-fry ginger in a hot wok with a little oil. Add peppers and pak choi.
Add prawns and cook 2–3 minutes until pink. Toss in oyster sauce.
Serve over brown rice.

name: Lamb & Lentil Stew
instructions: Brown diced lamb in batches. Soften onion in the same pan.
Return lamb, add lentils, tomatoes, stock, and ras el hanout. Simmer 30 minutes.
Season and serve with crusty bread or couscous.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and tikka paste for at least 10 minutes. Grill until charred.
Simmer tomatoes with extra tikka paste for 5 minutes, add remaining yogurt.
Add chicken, simmer 8 minutes, garnish with coriander and serve with rice.

name: Quinoa-Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Halve and deseed peppers. Mix quinoa, black beans, corn, and paprika.
Fill peppers with the quinoa mixture, top with grated cheese.
Bake at 190°C for 25–30 minutes until peppers are tender.

name: Pan-Fried Sea Bass with Asparagus
instructions: Score skin of sea bass, season well. Pan-fry skin-side down in hot oil for 4 minutes, flip for 2.
Roast asparagus and tomatoes at 200°C for 8 minutes.
Serve fish over vegetables with a squeeze of lemon and scattered capers.

name: Rice Cakes with Peanut Butter
instructions: Spread peanut butter evenly on rice cakes and serve.

name: Hard Boiled Eggs
instructions: Place eggs in cold water, bring to a boil, then cook for 9 minutes.
Cool in cold water, peel, and season with a pinch of sea salt.

name: Salted Edamame
instructions: Boil edamame pods in salted water for 4–5 minutes.
Drain, toss with extra sea salt, and serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Greek Yogurt with Granola
instructions: Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl, top with granola and drizzle with honey.

name: Banana Oat Energy Balls
instructions: Mash banana thoroughly and mix with oats, peanut butter, and chocolate chips.
Roll into 6 balls, refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before eating.

name: Turkey & Cucumber Roll-Ups
instructions: Spread a thin layer of Dijon mustard on each turkey slice.
Place a strip of cucumber at one end and roll up tightly. Secure with a cocktail stick if needed.

name: Trail Mix with Dark Chocolate
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl or portion bag.
Mix well and serve as a portable snack.
